payload.expected_edge: The prospectively defined mechanism may continue; exploratory exercise cannot establish whether that expectation is correct.
expected_failure_modes: one-bar volatility shock does not continue
breakout is a temporary liquidity sweep
modeled costs and adverse selection exceed any gross effect
payload.expected_market_regime: transition from ordinary to expanding volatility
invalidation_conditions: expansion true range below 1.5 times prior ATR20
expansion close does not exceed the prior 15-bar high
adjacent trigger close does not exceed expansion high
known_risks: modeled costs exceed any gross effect
payload.market_assumption: A large bullish range expansion that escapes a recent balance can continue when the immediately following bar confirms price and volume.
payload.mechanism: Volatility expansion activates stops and reveals directional demand; an adjacent higher close with abnormal same-clock participation tests whether that demand persists for at least the next-bar lifecycle.
required_evidence: twenty prior eligible same-clock volume observations
required_indicators: same-clock volume median over twenty prior eligible sessions
payload.title: Long adjacent-bar volatility-expansion breakout
